access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B open-weights checkpoint plus official FP8 sibling together with the hosted qwen3.8-27b API release of August 2026. The 2.4T Max flagship and its custom license, the qwen3.8-max-0902 snapshot, the max-preview and flash API lines, the experimental Flash-Next preview, earlier Qwen generations, QwenCloud product packaging, ModelScope mirrors, and community quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Permissively licensed dense 27B checkpoint with verbatim Apache-2.0 license file, documented SGLang, vLLM, and TokenSpeed recipes, and an official FP8 variant
First-party QwenCloud and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio serving under the exact qwen3.8-27b model ID plus documented Novita third-party serverless hosting
tradeoffs: The downloaded checkpoint is narrower than its API namesake, with smaller native context extended by YaRN versus the API default
Dense 27B still needs a high-memory single GPU or quantization for laptop-class self-operation
